Day, night and weather

A full day and night lasts 20 real minutes. Weather in a world follows the same 30-minute pattern, so you can plan around rain and storms. Nothing skips the night: the sun keeps moving, and you cannot sleep through it.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

Day and night

One day and night lasts 20 real minutes. The sun is up for about 10 minutes and down for about 10. New worlds start just after sunrise. Day and night

  • Night is darker and the moon is out. Nothing dangerous happens at night because of the time of day.
  • You cannot sleep or skip the night. Rest at home only sets your respawn point and restores stamina.
  • Birds sing in the morning. Night wildlife sounds take over after dark, unless it is raining or you are under a roof.

In survival, time of day also changes the air temperature. It is up to 9 C warmer at midday and up to 4.5 C cooler at night. Body temperature and shelter

Weather

  1. The weather cycle takes 30 minutes. Each step lasts about 3 minutes.
  2. The order is clear, cloudy, rain, cloudy, partly cloudy, foggy, cloudy, rainstorm, thunderstorm, cloudy. Then it starts again.
  3. The sky, rain and wind fade in and out between steps, so changes are gradual.

Each world starts at a different point in the cycle. The weather is the same across the whole world, so rain falls over deserts too. There is no snowfall. Automatic weather

  • Clear, partly cloudy and cloudy: no rain.
  • Rain: steady rain and light wind.
  • Rainstorm: heavy rain and strong wind, with no lightning.
  • Thunderstorm: heavy rain, the strongest wind and lightning with delayed thunder.
  • Foggy: low visibility and no rain.
  • Rain stops at the first solid or liquid block. A roof you build keeps the rain off you.
  • Under cover, rain is heard as a softer roof sound.
  • Lightning only flashes the sky and plays thunder. It does not damage you or set anything on fire.
  • In survival, rain lowers the air temperature by up to 2 C.

Wind strength changes with the weather, so sailing is affected too. Sailing: wind, speed and tacking

Hold the time or weather in creative

  1. Press Esc and open the World tab in Settings.
  2. Click a Time of day chip, or use its arrows, to hold Dawn, Day, Dusk or Night. Choose Cycle to go back to the normal day.
  3. Click a Weather chip, or use its arrows, to hold a weather. Choose Auto to go back to the normal pattern.
Key or actionWhat it does
AutoFollow the normal weather pattern.
Clear, Partly, CloudyDry skies with different amounts of cloud.
Rain, StormSteady rain, or a rainstorm without lightning.
ThunderHeavy rain with lightning and thunder.
FoggyDry, low-visibility mist.

The held time or weather stays in force if you switch to survival with F4. The row is saved with each world. In survival the rows only show the current state. Time, weather and season controls (creative)

Planned, not in the game yet

Planned, not in the game. Planned: darker nights, and regional weather where different parts of a world get different weather. Until these ship, the day length and weather pattern above are the same everywhere.
